scene poolparty1
: Gosh darn it. Where am I this time?
Greetings, Akira Arakawa. And welcome to the Oceanic Branch Office Waiting Room. It is here where you will await your appointment.
: What appointment? I don’t remember making an appointment. The last thing I remember is NOTHING AT ALL.
: Woah, weird. I’m pretty sure I just went through something seriously traumatic. And now it’s already gone?
It isn’t uncommon for UNVALUABLE MEMORIES to be cleansed from our members and prospective members upon arrival at the waiting room.
It’s important to keep our facilities clean and free of viruses so that all of our guests have a relaxing time waiting for their recoordination.
And thanks to new technology from the Shiawase Group, we were able to spray away your impurities without any resistance at all.
Don’t worry, though! Your unpleasant memories should come right back the moment your appointment concludes.
: No, it’s okay. You can keep them.
Unfortunately, we are unable to fit any additional dark-matter into our Box of Unpleasant Memories.
: Ugh. Fine. So what am I supposed to do then? Gather keys? Defeat enemies? Fill out magazine sweepstakes?
This is a waiting room. You are supposed to wait.
: That’s it?
That’s it! Then, once your number is called, you’ll report to Robbie Receptionson to confirm your identity.
As soon as the check-in process is complete, you will be taken to your coordinator’s office and begin the interview process.
: Okay. What’s my number?
Please feel free to speak to any of the other guests or help yourself to some refreshments if you find yourself with an excess amount of time.
: Sure. But what’s my number?
Additionally, the waiting room is currently doubling as a YMCA. Membership is not included in your recoordination appointment. Using the pool without a YMCA membership is prohibited.
: Please just tell me my number.
Good luck, Akira Arakawa! May your wait be as pleasant as it is dry.
: Ugh. These silly bureaucratic facilities never function properly. How am I supposed to wait for my number to be called if I don’t even know what my number is?
: Oh well...I guess I’ll just have to hope they call out my name as well. But in the meantime, I suppose I should get acquainted with everyone.
: It sounds like I might be here for a while.
